unacceptedDevelopmentAttempts: Lifecycle fixture initially changed the inventoried directory set; preallocated excluded artifact directory repaired this without weakening freshness.
CLI/MCP comparison initially included tool probe elapsed time; only timestamp/duration fields are normalized.
Supplemental bootstrap fixture exposed project shadowing in metadata probes; v2 probes now use isolated Python mode.
First full suite rejected a nonstandard Zod starts_with format; standard prefix regex and runtime/schema agreement controls repaired it.
Original port control failed because the ASGI server tuple retained the port in the hostname and defaulted to 80; separate hostname/port data repaired the native response.
One hierarchy mutant first failed by parsing absent JSON; the original callback now asserts collector exit status before decoding.
A provisional driver control count included an unrelated AST object; the final declared list has 37 independently killed/restored controls.
